offers.description: Available as an individual service pick ($1,000 USD for individuals / $2,000 USD for businesses, each for 5 days of live training + 5 days of dedicated support, 10 days total coverage), or as part of our comprehensive programs: Business Training ($5,000 USD for 60 days: 30d training + 30d guidance/materials, up to 20 seats, +$250/extra seat) or Personal Training ($2,500 USD for 30 days: 15d training + 15d guidance/materials, 1 person only). Clients are free to pick and choose their services. Full 195-country Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) supported across all service pricing.

serviceOutput: LangGraph & CrewAI Swarms: Architecting hierarchical supervisor-worker networks with dynamic sub-agent delegation.
Self-Correction & Reflection Loops: Building automated critique, Pydantic schema validation, and runtime retry graphs.
Docker & gVisor Sandboxing: Hardening isolated execution runtimes with timeout breakers and cycle limits.
Enterprise Tool-Calling Middleware: Implementing OpenAPI function calling across SQL databases, APIs, and microservices.
OpenTelemetry & Langfuse Tracing: Monitoring token burn, tool latency, and reasoning trajectories with full IP transfer.
